def _serve(lsock, sctx, outcomes, n):
    for _ in range(n):
        raw, _ = lsock.accept()
        try:
            s = sctx.wrap_socket(raw, server_side=True)
        except Exception as e:  # handshake failure
            outcomes.append("server-handshake-error: %r" % (e,))
            raw.close()
            continue
        outcomes.append("ok peercert=%s" % bool(s.getpeercert()))
        s.settimeout(1)
        try:
            s.recv(65536)
        except Exception:
            pass
        s.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")
        s.close()


def test_client_cert_leaks_across_sessions():
    ctx = req_adapters._preloaded_ssl_context
    ctx.load_verify_locations("tests/certs/valid/ca/ca.crt")
    ctx.verify_flags &= ~ssl.VERIFY_X509_STRICT

    sctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
    sctx.load_cert_chain("tests/certs/valid/server/server.pem", "tests/certs/valid/server/server.key")
    sctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_OPTIONAL
    sctx.load_verify_locations("tests/certs/expired/ca/ca.crt")

    lsock = socket.socket()
    lsock.bind(("localhost", 0))
    lsock.listen()
    port = lsock.getsockname()[1]
    outcomes = []
    t = threading.Thread(target=_serve, args=(lsock, sctx, outcomes, 3), daemon=True)
    t.start()
    url = f"https://localhost:{port}/"

    def fresh(**kw):
        s = requests.Session()
        s.trust_env = False
        try:
            return s.get(url, timeout=3, **kw).status_code
        except Exception as e:
            return "client-error: %s" % type(e).__name__

    results = [fresh(), fresh(cert=CLIENT_CERT), fresh()]
    t.join(5)
    lsock.close()
    print("\nclient results:", results)
    print("server outcomes:", outcomes)
    assert results[0] == 200  # control: no cert presented, handshake ok
    assert results[2] != 200  # fresh cert-less session now presents leaked cert
EOF
